newsitem.title: TURKEY: 39 dead in Turkish clashes with Kurd rebels.
newsitem.headline: 39 dead in Turkish clashes with Kurd rebels.

text.p: Security forces have killed 33 Kurd guerrillas for the loss of six soldiers in recent clashes in southeast Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement on Monday.
The statement said the clashes took place in the southeastern provinces of Sirnak, Mardin, Hakkari, Bingol, Batman, Diyarbakir and Van over the last five days.
More than 20,000 people have been killed during the 12-year-old armed conflict between troops and Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas, fighting for autonomy or independence from Ankara.
